definitions.explanation: The half of the Earth south of the equator. Includes most of South America, Africa, Australia, and Antarctica.

examples.japanese: オーストラリアは{南半球|みなみはんきゅう}にある。
examples.english: Australia is in the Southern Hemisphere.

examples.japanese: {南半球|みなみはんきゅう}では{季節|きせつ}が{逆|ぎゃく}になる。
examples.english: In the Southern Hemisphere, the seasons are reversed.

examples.japanese: {南半球|みなみはんきゅう}の{国|くに}では{十二月|じゅうにがつ}が{夏|なつ}なので、クリスマスを{海|うみ}で{過|す}ごす{人|ひと}もいる。
examples.english: In Southern Hemisphere countries, December is summer, so some people spend Christmas at the beach.

notes: Compound of {南|みなみ} (south) + {半球|はんきゅう} (hemisphere). The opposite is {北半球|きたはんきゅう} (Northern Hemisphere). Japan is located in the {北半球|きたはんきゅう}. A common topic in geography classes and when discussing differences in seasons between Japan and countries like Australia or New Zealand.
